yt_posts.topic: Pairing a meme to a perp did a 110x: the four-step narrative ladder and why stonk season leads the next leg
yt_posts.body_style: narrative arc: four-step evolution of paired meme coins (stock pair, stock rewards, $TAO pair, perp pair), the community 110x and STONK receipts, the stonk-season thesis, the two catalysts, the caveat
yt_posts.body:
A meme coin paired to a leveraged perp position sounds like the dumbest idea in crypto. One of them just did a 110x from my community's alert. Here is the four-step ladder that got us there, and why I think stonk season is the narrative that leads the next leg up.

Two months ago the idea was simple: launch a meme, but pair it with a tokenized stock instead of SOL. StonkFun on Solana pairs launches against xStocks like NVDAx, so the meme trades against NVIDIA. That was step one.

Step two: pay the holders in the stock. Robinhood Chain ran its own version of this over the summer. Boomer sends stock-token rewards (SPY, Costco, Microsoft and more) straight to holders' wallets. Hold the meme, get paid in stock tokens.

Step three: swap the stock for a big cap. The same launchpad now pairs coins against $TAO, ZEC and HYPE, so holding a meme becomes a way to collect Bittensor exposure instead of NVIDIA.

Step four is the strange one: pair the coin to a perpetual. Perps Pad launches Solana coins tied to a perp position, and each coin runs a leveraged perp treasury that buys and burns on the way up. When the alert hit my Discord the token was sitting under a $100K market cap, and we rode it to a 110x; it peaked near a $10M cap on September 13. STONK, the launchpad token itself, went from about $30M when we got in to a peak near $300M on September 11.

That is the pattern I care about, not any single ticker. Every leg of this market gets a narrative. Robinhood summer was the last one. The next leg gets stonk season: memes that pay you in something you already wanted, paired to stocks, to big caps, and now to perps. A meme that pays you in tokenized Tesla is a more enticing hold than a picture of a dog, and the market is figuring that out in real time.

Two catalysts sit on the calendar: the Clarity Act cloture vote on September 15 and the Fed decision on September 16. A 25 bps hike is 88% priced in on Polymarket, so a hike is business as usual; a hold is the surprise, and surprises are what send this market flying. Either one landing does it. Neither, and October does it anyway.

Plenty of these retrace 50% first. Perps Pad is already well off its top. Some will rug outright. Never financial advice. Never.

So commit in the comments: which pairing leads the next leg, a tokenized stock, a big cap like $TAO, or a perp position? And if you think pairing a meme to leverage is the top signal, say that too.

Hit like and subscribe if you want the next narrative before it has a name.
